Super Earth
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to any Jack Russell Terrier 6 months and older. 1 second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached and then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty. Electric timers are used - please note the electric timing eye we use makes a beep!

Super Earth
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to any Jack Russell Terrier 6 months and older. 1 second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached and then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty. Electric timers are used - please note the electric timing eye we use makes a beep!

Brush Hunt (Non-Sanctioned)
How fast can your terrier find the rat? This is a timed event in which the terrier hunts for a rat placed in a ventilated PVC tube hidden in an enclosed horse stall or similar area. Watch your terrier look for the rat as he maneuvers through a natural setting and other obstacles. You may enter as many times as you like, but only the first run is considered for ribbon placement.

Nosework
Sanctioned event, open to JRT six months and older who are capable of alerting to the target odors. Level 1 target odor is birch. Level 2 target odors are birch, anise and clove. A Level 1 title is not required to enter Level 2 classes. Time faults incurred for dropped food, failure to go through start-line marker, excessive disturbance of search area, incorrect call in Level 1 and failure to call finish in Level 2 searches. Eliminating (pee, poop or vomit) in a search area ends the search and results in a non-qualifying score and no placement. Consult the rulebook for more detailed information. First through sixth ribbons for each class determined by correct calls with fastest time first. Champion and reserve champion ribbons awarded to top two JRTs in Level 1 and top two JRTs in Level 2 by combining scores for all elements/classes. Teams with no faults considered first.
